summary: GG2026 Phase 5: Company Article System - ALL 30 backend tests PASS, ALL frontend features verified. Company-specific editorial article layer at /{company}/makaleler/{article-slug} fully functional.

POST /api/company-articles.details: Creates article with company_slug, article_type, auto-generates slug from title, validates required fields

GET /api/company-articles/{base_slug}.details: Returns site info, articles list, sub_pages internal links, hub_links, breadcrumb, SEO data. tulipbet has 2 test articles.

GET /api/company-articles/{base_slug}/{a.details: Returns full article with related_articles, related_sub_pages (filtered by cluster), related_hubs, similar_company_links, breadcrumb

GET /api/sitemap-company-articles.xml.details: Valid XML with article URLs (/company/makaleler/slug) and listing page URLs for all 264 firms

CompanyArticlesListPage.details: Renders company info, articles list (6 cards shown), sidebar CTA, sub-pages links, hub links

CompanyArticlePage.details: Renders full article content, related company pages, related hubs, similar companies, breadcrumb

Article taxonomy.details: 9 article types defined: deneme-bonusu-rehberi, hosgeldin-bonusu-rehberi, bonus-sartlari, giris-rehberi, mobil-giris-rehberi, odeme-rehberi, inceleme, karsilastirma, guvenilirlik-analizi

Article-to-company relationship.details: Articles linked by company_slug, related_sub_pages shown on article page based on cluster

Article-to-hub relationship.details: related_hubs shown based on article cluster (bonus-guide -> BONUS_HUB_PAGES, company-guide -> PAYMENT_HUB_PAGES)

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real, no mocking used

seed_data_creation: 2 test articles created for tulipbet: tulipbet-deneme-bonusu-rehberi (bonus-guide) and tulipbet-giris-rehberi (company-guide)
context_for_next_testing_agent: GG2026 Phase 5 Company Article System complete. company_articles collection stores articles linked by company_slug. 9 article_type values with cluster mapping (bonus-guide, company-guide). Article detail page shows related_sub_pages filtered by cluster. CompanySubPage sidebar now has 'Makaleler' link. sitemap-company-articles.xml generates URLs for both articles and listing pages for all 264 firms.
